_about: Changes applied on top of the upstream strings in Export/. Run `python tools/patch.py` after editing; output goes to Patched/.

operations._about: Field overrides for upstream operations, by module then operation name. Rule used: no floor under 60%, low-volume items (patterns, xmog) at 70%.

new_operations._about: Operations upstream doesn't ship. Every field is listed so TSM doesn't reset anything on import. Mailing can't be imported or exported by TSM, so it's set up in game.

Snipe Deals._about: Flag listings under 60% of the lower of realm/region market, or under vendor price.

Buy Below Market._about: Group searches only show listings at or under 80% of the lower market value. No restock cap.

Vendor Junk._about: Sell to a merchant only when the AH value is under 125% of vendor price. Items with no price data are never sold (fallback 999999g). Soulbound items are skipped.

Craft Gear._about: Crafted gear: keep 2 on hand, queue only when short by 1+, and only if profit is at least max(5g, 20% of craft cost).

Craft Supplies._about: Bars, parts, consumables, bags: keep 20 on hand, queue in batches of 5+, only if profit is at least max(1g, 15% of craft cost).

Move All._about: Bank <-> bags moves the whole stack, nothing kept behind. Used on the bank alt to pull everything for posting and bank leftovers.

assign._about: Operations to put on each file's top-level group (subgroups inherit). "*" applies to every file except those in leave_unassigned. A subgroup that overrides a module upstream is left alone.

subgroups._about: Give a subgroup its own operation (sets override, so it beats what the top-level group or upstream set). Children inherit it.

leave_unassigned._about: Files kept with no operations at all, so TSM never posts, snipes, vendors or moves them.
